ev.q: VE against COVID-19–associated ED/UC encounters was 51% (95% CI = 47%–54%) in the first 7–59 days after an updated dose
Odds ratios (ORs) and 95% CIs were estimated using multivariable logistic regression
VISION regression models were adjusted for age, sex, race and ethnicity, calendar day, and geographic region
using a test-negative, case-control design with data from two CDC VE networks
